lower_bound.quote:
Claim: for every positive integer $t$,
$$t \mid \alpha \ \text{and}\ t \mid \beta
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
t \mid \alpha' \ \text{and}\ t \mid \beta'.$$
(standard; details omitted).
lower_bound.witness: The forward divisibility mechanism is not proved: for every positive t, one must show that t dividing both α and β implies t divides min(α,β) and |α−β|. The passage states this equivalence but explicitly omits its argument.
lower_bound.load_bearing: This direction is needed to show that every common divisor of the old valuation tuple remains a common divisor after a move, so the tuple gcd cannot decrease.

upper_bound.quote:
Claim: for every positive integer $t$,
$$t \mid \alpha \ \text{and}\ t \mid \beta
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
t \mid \alpha' \ \text{and}\ t \mid \beta'.$$
(standard; details omitted).
upper_bound.witness: The reverse divisibility mechanism is not proved: for every positive t, one must show that t dividing min(α,β) and |α−β| implies t divides both α and β, including all orderings of α and β. The passage merely labels this standard and omits the proof.
upper_bound.load_bearing: This reverse direction is needed to show that a move creates no new common divisor of the valuation tuple, so the tuple gcd cannot increase. Without both directions, Step 3's invariance conclusion is unsupported.

parsed.notes: Part (a) is fully proved. The formula for M is correct, but its decisive prime-wise invariance rests on a true equivalence whose proof is explicitly omitted.
